summary: The Inn & Hotel guest core works in-game on RimWorld 1.7. Every normal bed now has a "Guest bed" toggle, and its inspect string shows a live price per night. The price is the base price × room class (economy, standard, deluxe, suite or royal, from a room score built from impressiveness, space, cleanliness, furniture and temperature) × occupancy (single 1.35, two-bed 1.10, dorm 0.85, hallway 0.72) × bed quality × renown stars, rounded to 5. Colonists never use guest beds, and guests only use their own booked guest bed (rescued guests may still use medical beds). Without a guest bed or a venue nothing happens at all; a two-day test confirms this. The first guest bed builds "Guest Wing 1" around its room plus any venue rooms reachable through doors, and starts a 5-day arrival forecast; the first group comes within 1.5–3 days. Groups come from friendly factions, at most 1–6 guests and never more than the free beds. They arrive in the afternoon on foot from the nearest reachable map edge, or by drop pod when the walk is long and the faction is industrial or better. Two mutually hostile factions are never on the map together. Guests check in at the new front desk, which is also the till spot (without a desk they walk to the rooms and check themselves in). They pick a bed by the utility formula from concept 5.11 and pay the first night through GuestApi.ChargeGuest. Industrial+ guests with a budget over 300 pay by card from a ledger account; everyone else pays cash from silver in their inventory. They then sleep in their bed at night, give a morning verdict on the room (a mood thought from −10 to +5), and pay each further night in the evening. Otherwise they eat the food they brought, try GuestActivities.TryPick, use building-only recreation and wander inside their wing. They leave at check-out (or earlier if miserable for a long time or out of money). At departure the game rolls 0..+5 goodwill per guest (capped at +15 per faction per quadrum, never pushing above 75 by hosting alone); bad stays cost −1..−5 on Standard Room. Renown and Whispers change, and a dry departure letter arrives with a star rating, totals, 1 of 15 opening lines and one line per guest. Each guest has gizmos for handling (Basics / Accompany / Recruit) and Send away. Accompany and Recruit are carried out by a real Hosting work giver; recruit talks can offend the guest, and a guest whose bond with the colony is high enough may join at departure.
implemented: Guest register (GameComponent GuestRegistry, saved): GuestRecord subclasses the contract's GuestInfo and adds the bed, nights, money, mood and service figures, value/expectation, handling state and an event log (at most 40 entries) with a highlight for the report; GuestGroup records; fast HashSet lookups for patches; GuestApi.Impl is set in OnDefsLoaded via GuestApiBridge

Caretaker checks Inn.GuestRecords (records with no pawn, or whose pawn is dead, despawned, has no lord, is in a foreign lord or has joined the colony; also rebuilds the index) and Inn.GuestBedOwners (frees guest beds owned by non-guests); every fix is logged

Guest beds: CompHH_GuestBed is added in OnDefsLoaded to every humanlike Building_Bed def (no cribs or deathrest caskets, no cloned defs); toggle gizmo (UI/HH/Inn/GuestBed); inactive while the bed is medical, prisoner or slave; colonist owners are released when a bed is switched on; GuestBeds per-map registry

Pricing (GuestBedPricing): room score RS 0–100 cached per room for 250 ticks; room classes Economy/Standard/Deluxe/Suite/Royal (×1/2/4/8/16); occupancy single 1.35 / two-bed 1.10 / dorm 0.85 / hallway 0.72; bed quality factor; stars factor 1+0.1·(stars−3); rounded to 5; the breakdown is shown in the inspect string

Patches: RestUtility.IsValidBedFor postfix (colonists blocked from guest beds, guests limited to their booked bed); CompAssignableToPawn_Bed.CanAssignTo postfix (assign dialog refuses colonists); ForbidUtility.InAllowedArea postfix (wing restriction, early-out on a HashSet of restricted guests only); Pawn_NeedsTracker.ShouldHaveNeed postfix (guests get the Joy need)

Scheduler MapComponent_HH_GuestScheduler: active only with a guest bed or a venue (N08); first group 1.5–3 days after activation; Poisson top-up of a 5-day forecast at 0.6 groups/day × renown curve × capacity × arrival-rate setting; group size 1+Poisson(1+0.015R+0.25·years) capped by the setting; overnight groups in the afternoon, day visitors in opening hours (window taken from Venues); hostile factions never planned for overlapping windows and EnemyPresent checked on arrival; public Forecast / GetForecast(days) / NextArrival / RatePerDay

Arrival: IncidentDef HH_GuestGroupArrival (base chance 0; also usable from the dev menu) with IncidentWorker_HH_GuestGroupArrival; pawn kinds from the faction's Peaceful group maker (Trader guards as fallback); entry at the nearest reachable edge cell to the front desk or bed, drop pods (Industrial+) beyond the pod-distance setting; creepjoiners, mutants, prisoners and slaves are filtered out; guests receive packed food; arrival letter for the first 3 groups, a message afterwards

Wealth W (renown band table + tech bonus + royal title), daily budget b(W) piecewise curve, budget = b(W)·days^0.85·rand·guest-money setting·pod 1.6·Greedy/Ascetic, expectation E from 5.6, bed utility U from 5.11, comfort price

Money: cash guests carry silver stacks in their inventory; card guests are funded world → guest:<thingID> at arrival and the remainder goes back to world at departure or file closing; IPaymentProvider 'inn.card' (priority 50); nights are charged via GuestApi.ChargeGuest into the colony till ('Inn: night in … (cash|card)'); a night is only re-charged once it has been slept

LordJob_HH_GuestStay with LordToil_HH_Stay (duty HH_GuestStay); leave on memo HH_Leave; dangerous temperatures → leave; wounded present → TakeWoundedGuest; became hostile → ExitMapAndDefendSelf; each unplanned exit settles the stay via TransitionAction_HH_Settle; Notify_PawnLost reports exits, deaths, arrests and recruitment to the register; gizmos and the inspect report come through the LordJob (no Harmony patch needed)

Think tree of HH_GuestStay: JobGiver_HH_CheckIn (front desk, or walk to the guest rooms and self check-in) → JobGiver_HH_GuestSleep (booked bed at night or when exhausted) → JobGiver_HH_EatPacked (own food only) → JobGiver_HH_GuestActivity (GuestActivities.TryPick, cooldown) → JobGiver_HH_GuestJoy (vanilla joy givers that only use buildings) → JobGiver_HH_WanderWing; JobDriver_HH_CheckIn (faster when a Hosting colonist stands next to the desk)
Front desk HH_FrontDesk: Building_FrontDesk, 2x1, Graphic_Multi, stuff-based (no research needed), CompTillSpot, interaction cell, inspect string with check-ins and the next forecast group

Guest wings: Area_HH_GuestWing (an Area subclass, but stored in MapComponent_HH_GuestWings instead of the vanilla area manager, so it adds nothing to the vanilla area limit and leaves no unknown Area class in the vanilla area list of a save if the mod is removed) with its own drawer; Expand and Shrink designators added to the vanilla Zone menu (or HH_Hospitality if that category exists), with a wing picker and a 'new wing' option; auto wing from the bed room plus venue rooms reached by a door search up to 4 steps, never colonist bedrooms, prisons, outdoor or huge rooms; guests are always allowed in their own bed and in any venue room

Satisfaction and departure: mood mean sampled every 250 ticks, service score, V and S=V−E, Satisfaction=clamp(2·S); early leave after 8 h at very low satisfaction (setting), or when money runs out; goodwill points clamp(round(10·(M̄−0.35)+4·S+rand)) 0..5, bad stays −1..−5 capped by the tier setting, −1 if insulted; +15 per faction per quadrum cap and 75 ceiling; HistoryEventDef HH_HostedGuests; renown ΔR formula from 5.7 with the per-group loss cap and the start-value floor on easy tiers; daily renown drift towards 20 and whispers decay; arrest renown −/whispers +5; a death renown −/whispers +4

Departure report: letter, message or off (setting); header with stars, money spent, goodwill and renown change; 15 opening lines (5 outcomes × 3), a line for early, sent-away, weather or hostile departures, one line per guest (room, nights, money spent, payment method, goodwill points, highlight of the stay)

Handling modes: gizmo cycles Basics → Accompany → Recruit (icons UI/HH/Inn/Handling_*), shows the bond while recruiting; WorkGiver HH_AccompanyGuest (work type HH_Hosting) + JobDriver: chitchat/deep talk, guest company thought by the host's Social skill (+1..+4), service +0.1 once per day, Social XP; Recruit: HH_HostedWell social memory (opinion +8, up to 10 stacks), insult chance from 5.10 (−6 thought, budget ×0.7, leaves half a day sooner, −1 point); at departure, bond (sum of colonist opinions of the guest) ≥ 30+4n → chance clamp(0.35+0.5S+0.01·excess) → DoRecruit plus goodwill cost clamp(5+MV/200+30/(1+settlements),5,40); faction leaders and nobles never join; Send away gizmo with confirmation (no points, renown −1, card refund)

23 settings (prefix inn.) with tier anchors from 9.2/9.4: arrivalRate, guestMoney, priceTolerance, expectationOffset, goodwillLossCap, renownLossCap; plus maxGroupSize, firstGuestMin/MaxDays, dayVisitors, forecastDays, podDistance, arrivalNotice, stayNightsMin/Max, leaveEarly, checkIn/OutHour, priceBase, cardThreshold, goodwillCapQuadrum, goodwillCeiling, autoWing, insultBase, reportMode

Guest overview page (HearthTabs, Id 'inn.overview'): renown and stars, forecast, staying guests with room, price, budget, satisfaction and handling; clicking a row jumps to the guest; tooltip shows the event log
Hospitality (12.6): only a warning in the log when the original or Continued Hospitality is active
Diagnosis lines and PrepareRemoval (sends groups home and returns card funds)

Keyed HH_Inn.xml (181 keys) generated by tools/inn/gen_keyed.py from the English fallbacks in code + settings + computed keys; thought, job, duty, workgiver, incident and history defs all have labels and descriptions
not_done: The day-visitor path (venue opening hours, last orders) is coded but has not been tested in-game: this worktree has no VenueTypeDef or venue-sign building; it needs the ShopsFood module's signs
Archetypes, interests, desire counters and the activity planner weights from 5.3/5.6 are not done: only the generic GuestActivities.TryPick is used

Return visits, gift on leaving, scandal events, Critic, whispers-weighted arrivals, door policy/filters (5.9), the travel bag, and the visible wallet apparel (5.15) are not done: out of scope for the core loop
The '5 % arrival discount' for own transport, shuttle or taxi arrivals, and the wealth-based pod arrival beyond the distance rule are not done; drop pods are the only far-arrival mode
Waiting-room, night bell and incident thoughts (waiting, cleanliness, price vs expectation as vanilla thoughts) are not done: only the room verdict, company and pestered thoughts exist

The wing status line ('Bedroom ✓ · Kitchen ✗'), concierge tips, the 'Use this bed as guest bed' offer letter, the auto-assignment of Hosting priorities, and the auto-separation of hostile groups into different wings are not done
Group-member bed sharing (couples in double beds, multi-slot renting) is not done: one guest per bed
No save/load roundtrip test: reloading inside the test harness would restart the runner; the ExposeData of every class was written for it but has not been run in-game

Guests' lords use a LordJob class from our assembly, so removing the mod with guests on the map can still log a lord-load error; PrepareRemoval sends guests home first, but a dedicated removal test is missing
Not built or checked for 1.6 or 1.5: written against 1.7 APIs (PlanetTile, tickIntervalAction, PawnDiscardDecideMode)

integration_notes: Public entry points: Hearth.Guests.GuestRegistry.Instance (Get(pawn) → GuestRecord, Records, Groups, Renown, Whispers, Stars, StarsText(), DepartGroup, SendAway, Notify_Incident(pawn, amount, text), GizmosFor, ReportFor), GuestRegistry.IsRegisteredGuest(pawn) and IsWingRestricted(pawn) (HashSet, cheap); MapComponent_HH_GuestScheduler (Forecast, GetForecast(days), NextArrival(), RatePerDay(), OpeningWindow(), static FactionCanVisit/EnemyPresent, static SuspendedForTests); GuestArrival.TryFire(map, GuestArrivalRequest) to force an arrival (Size, Kind, Nights, ForceDigital, ForceBudget, ForcePod, Silent, StayTicksOverride); GuestBeds.On/FreeOn/CountOn/IsGuestBed(map/thing); GuestBedPricing.Quote(bed) → BedQuote; GuestWings.Comp(map)/WingFor(pawn)/AllowedFor(pawn, cell)
GuestApi.Info(p) returns a GuestRecord (subclass of GuestInfo); modules may cast to Hearth.Guests.GuestRecord for room/nights; Events is capped at 40
GuestApi.IsGuest is false once a stay is settled (guest walking home), so venues do not sell to leaving guests
Venue rooms are always allowed for wing-restricted guests (AllowedFor checks Venues.All), so ShopsFood/Casino activities work even outside the wing

Activities: JobGiver_HH_GuestActivity asks GuestActivities.TryPick at most every 600 ticks per guest, after sleep and eating and before recreation and wandering; overnight guests must be checked in first

Ledger accounts: guest:<thingIDNumber> for card guests (funded from world at arrival, remainder back to world at departure, file closing or recruitment); night payments land in Payments.ColonyTill(map) with memo 'Inn: night in … (cash|card)'
Payment provider id 'inn.card', priority 50 (above the core cash provider)
Settings keys all start with 'inn.' (see InnSettings constants); tier anchors on inn.arrivalRate, inn.guestMoney, inn.priceTolerance, inn.expectationOffset, inn.goodwillLossCap, inn.renownLossCap
Main-tab page registered as HearthTabPage Id 'inn.overview' (Order 10); the UI module may replace or hide it and draw its own overview from the same public API
Wing designators are added at runtime to DesignationCategoryDef HH_Hospitality if it exists, else Zone (specialDesignatorClasses + resolved designators)

Defs added: HH_FrontDesk (ThingDef), HH_GuestStay (DutyDef), HH_CheckIn and HH_AccompanyGuest (JobDefs), HH_AccompanyGuest (WorkGiverDef on HH_Hosting), HH_GuestGroupArrival (IncidentDef, base chance 0), HH_HostedGuests (HistoryEventDef), thoughts HH_GuestRoomVerdict, HH_GuestAccompanied, HH_GuestPestered, HH_HostedWell

Test-only hooks: GuestRegistry.RecruitChanceOverride, BondThresholdOverride, AddRawRecordForTests, ResetGoodwillBookForTests; MapComponent_HH_GuestScheduler.SuspendedForTests (Inn suites switch it off and back on)
